name: overstory
description: Multi-agent orchestration for Claude Code — spawn worker agents in git worktrees via tmux, coordinate through SQLite mail, merge with tiered conflict resolution
author: Jaymin West

scripts.check: bun run test && bun run lint && bun run typecheck
scripts.build: bun build --compile --outfile overstory src/index.ts && bun build --compile --outfile overstory-bridge src/codex/bridge.ts
